editorial:
Imagine you are on a community service trip with a few other troublemakers in the middle of nowhere. You arrive in a tiny village called Mortlake that feels like it stopped existing a hundred years ago. At first, the locals seem weird and quiet, but you quickly realize they are way more dangerous than they look. One small fight leads to a total disaster, and suddenly you are running for your life in a place where the people are related in ways that make you want to look away. It is a wild ride that mixes gross-out humor with scary moments, making you feel like you are trapped in a bad dream that just keeps getting weirder.

The gore is over-the-top and definitely not for everyone, but if you love movies that do not take themselves seriously, you will have a blast. The pacing is quick, and the shock value is high. While the acting is simple, it fits the goofy tone of the film perfectly. You should definitely check this out if you enjoy campy horror. For the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or grabbing the 4K Blu-ray for your collection so you can see all the messy details in high definition.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a brutal fight for survival. Most of the group gets killed off in creative and gross ways by the village locals. Eventually, the last survivor manages to escape the madness of Mortlake. The twist is that there is no real help coming, and the village is just a hole of madness. You end up seeing that the locals are completely insane and committed to their weird way of life until the very end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gross-out horror and dark comedy.
